subject: Re: SpICE kickoff: intelligibility assessment as a service
body:
Goran,

Resourcing and compute.

People: Linnea 80% on model work and the eval battery (TORGO, UASpeech, ALS-TDI PMP plus our realistic-speech set), Milan 70% on the serving wrapper and API, Paloma 40% on data pipelines, Emeka 50% on partner integration and the confidence-reporting layer.

Compute: inference-scale work rides Titan best-effort through April. The big item is the June retrain: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation - 128 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-01 - for the full retraining run on the pooled corpus. That's sized from the half-million-utterance training base; one week covers the retrain plus two eval passes if configs are frozen beforehand.

Dependencies: privacy review filed Mar 16 (Kofi's queue). Also the released PyTorch variant is still "coming soon" upstream, so everything v1 is Keras/TFHub-based - fine for serving, worth noting for partners with torch stacks.

Apr 17 milestone looks solid.

Ivo
